note: v1902: Every neighbouring piece of live state takes an isolated TV_HIST along with it, but the vault ledger - the record of what he owns - and the vault swept memo and the learned dead-frame file were bare HERE joins, so a sweep driven against a fixture hist wrote into his real tree. Nothing has hit it and that is exactly why it was worth fixing: what stopped it was the discipline of every fixture written so far, not the path, and the ledger is merge-max so nothing it gained would ever be subtracted. Three chronicle files had the softer version, isolating only when a test remembered their own env var. All of them derive from the hist now and the guard is the class rather than the instances - it asks all eleven written state paths where they live with and without TV_HIST and fails any that stays in his tree.
